title: 第三章化形、生而为人

content_zh:
好在皇天不负有心人，这片空间也良心发现了似乎这孩子也够可怜的，就让他出来吧！于是，这个沉寂了不知多少岁月的空间终于是发生了变化。只见顶部裂开，似乎是花朵绽放，祥瑞纷呈，七色光彩围绕，似是万千彩带垂落，大道之音弥漫，好一个仙家祥瑞景象，让风洛不由自主地沉迷进去。不过片刻，风洛就回过神来，抓住这难得的机会向着那头顶的开口飞出去。明亮的天空，呼呼，耳边掠过的清风让风洛万般迷醉，风啊，终于是要出来了。“哗啦，哗啦”的声音响起，风洛低头一看，原来是在一湖面上，顿时，“哈哈哈哈哈哈，老子终于出来了，终于离开那鬼地方了，哈哈哈哈，自由了，呜呜呜呜。”激动得大喊大笑的风洛不由得哭了，苦啊，可怜的孩子一醒来就发现被困住，而且一困就是不知到多少万年，如今终于重见天日，情绪都失控了。“我再也不做宅男了，我要人、我要说话、我要灵宝。”神智有点混乱的风洛说出了前世他父母期望他要做到的事，不得不说，要是他老爸老妈听到这，肯定会万分高兴的。“失态了失态了，怎么说也是个神仙了，怎么能这么不理智呢，要改要改，想要灵宝在心中想想就行，怎么喊出来了，这不是破坏我形象吗？咳咳。”作为神仙中人的风洛大神连忙稳住情绪，不再胡思乱想。不过回想起过去的日子，还真是不堪回首。
在空间中这么多年来的不断探索，一个人走动，就这么过来一个生灵都没有，甚至连一丝声音都闻不到，除了自己自言自语就什么都没有了，这让作为宅男、得道仙人的风洛都癫狂了。虽说修道之人一闭关静坐就是无数年，但是自己的情况可大不相同啊！自从度过心魔之后，元神就不用再陷入沉睡，而是时刻清醒着的，就这样，无法修炼，无人聊天，再宅的人也受不了这寂寞无声的环境啊，这无边的孤寂可是会把人折磨疯的。这也多亏了前世自己就喜欢安静的环境，并不是那种活跃之人，就自己一个人也能自己呆着，如今再加上修道之人的坚毅这才堪堪顶了过来。“呼，不想了，苦日子终于过去了，洪荒世界，哥来了。”摇头甩了甩脑中的念头，心情变得欢快起来。不过想起自己还只是元神，身体都没有，不由一阵沮丧，还是快点化形吧！
“咦，什么东西，竟然对元神有这么大的吸引力，要不是及时控制住，连元神都不由自主地冲过去？”突然间元神一阵颤抖，似要飞向某地，不过被风洛压下去了。按捺不住好奇心的风洛顺着元神指引的方向走去，看看到底是什么灵物让元神如此渴望。当然他也不怕遇到危险，毕竟他还是相信自己的判断的，有危险的话元神也会自动预警。竟然是湖底传来的，走到尽头一看，在一根植物的根底下，一粒拳头大小，泛着淡黄色光晕的物体，越靠近元神颤抖得越厉害，元神几乎要脱离掌控了，风洛连忙控制住心神，元神之力包裹住灵物飞快地向地面行去，同时心中也激动万分，宝物啊，这肯定是一桩宝物，不然如何让元神如此渴望，没想到刚一出来就有如此收获。

content_en:
Fortunately, Huangtian has paid off, and this space has found its conscience. It seems that this child is pitiful enough, so let him come out! As a result, this space that had been silent for countless years finally changed. I saw that the top was cracked, as if flowers were blooming, auspicious and auspicious, surrounded by seven-color brilliance, like thousands of colorful ribbons hanging down, and the sound of the avenue filled the air. It was such an auspicious scene of an immortal family that Feng Luo could not help but indulge in it. Within a moment, Feng Luo came to his senses and seized this rare opportunity to fly towards the opening above his head. The bright sky was whirring, and the breeze passing by his ears made Feng Luo intoxicated. The wind was finally coming out. The sound of "wow, wah" sounded, and Feng Luo lowered his head and saw that he was on a lake. He suddenly said, "Hahahahahaha, I'm finally out, I'm finally out of that damn place, hahahaha, free, oooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo... "I won't be an otaku anymore. I want people, I want to talk, and I want spiritual treasures." Feng Luo, who was a little confused, said what his parents expected him to do in his previous life. I have to say that if his parents heard this, they would definitely be extremely happy. "I've lost my composure. I'm a god after all. How can I be so irrational? If I want to change it, I just want Lingbao to think about it in his heart. Why did he shout it out? Isn't this destroying my image? Ahem." As a god among gods, Fengluo Master quickly calmed down his emotions and stopped thinking wildly. But when I think back to the past days, it’s really hard to look back.
After so many years of continuous exploration in the space, walking around alone, there was not a single soul, not even a sound, and there was nothing except himself talking to himself. This made Feng Luo, an otaku and a Taoist immortal, crazy. Although those who practice Taoism spend countless years meditating in seclusion, their own situation is quite different! Since overcoming the inner demon, the soul no longer needs to fall into deep sleep, but is always awake. Just like this, unable to practice, no one to chat with, even the most at home can't stand this lonely and silent environment. This boundless loneliness can torture people crazy. This is also thanks to the fact that I liked a quiet environment in my previous life. I was not the kind of active person and could stay by myself. Now, coupled with the perseverance of a cultivator, I was able to withstand this. "Huh, I don't want to think about it anymore. The hard days are finally over. In the ancient world, brother is here." He shook his head to shake off the thoughts in his mind, and his mood became cheerful. But when I remembered that I was still just a soul and didn’t have a body, I couldn’t help but feel depressed, so I had better transform myself quickly!
"Hey, what could be so attractive to the Yuan Shen? If it wasn't controlled in time, even the Yuan Shen would rush over involuntarily?" Suddenly the Yuan Shen trembled and seemed to fly somewhere, but was suppressed by Feng Luo. Unable to restrain his curiosity, Feng Luo walked in the direction guided by Yuanshen to see what spiritual object the Yuanshen desired so much. Of course, he is not afraid of danger. After all, he still trusts his own judgment. If there is danger, his soul will automatically warn him. It turned out to be coming from the bottom of the lake. When I walked to the end, I saw under the root of a plant, an object the size of a fist with a light yellow halo. The closer the Yuanshen was, the more violently it trembled. The Yuanshen was almost out of control. Feng Luo quickly controlled his mind. The power of the Yuanshen wrapped the spiritual object and walked quickly to the ground. At the same time, he was very excited in his heart. Treasure, this must be a treasure. Otherwise, how could the Yuanshen be so eager for it? He didn't expect to have such a harvest as soon as he came out.
